question: What is the prize money awarded to the champions of the IPL 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹20 Crore.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The IPL 2025 final winners received a prize money of ₹20 Crore, with the runners-up getting ₹13 Crore.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Winning Prize:** The champions of IPL 2025, Royal Challengers Bengaluru were awarded ₹20 Crore, consistent with amounts since 2022.
 
• **Runners-up Prize:** The losing finalist Punjab Kings received ₹13 Crore as prize money.
 
• **Prize Money Growth:** The prize money has increased significantly since 2008, when champions received ₹4.8 Crore.
 
• **Individual Awards:** Alongside team prizes, individual honors such as Player of the Tournament and Emerging Player of the Year were given.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **IPL Prize History:** The first IPL champions, Rajasthan Royals, earned ₹4.8 Crore in 2008, showcasing growth in tournament finances.
 
• **Venue:** The final is held at Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad, amid concerns of rain disruptions.
 
• **Monetary Incentives:** These prizes incentivize teams and contribute to the growing commercial stature of the IPL.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The IPL 2025 season came to an end with Royal Challengers Bengaluru triumphing over Punjab Kings in a memorable final, with Krunal Pandya winning his second Final player of the match award for a special display of defensive spin bowling to finish with figures of 2-17.
 
• Winner: Royal Challengers Bengaluru
 
• Runner Up: Punjab Kings
 
• Most Valuable Player: Suryakumar Yadav (MI) – 717 runs, avg 65, SR 168
 
• Purple Cap: Prasidh Krishna (GT) – 25 wickets
 
• Emerging Player: Sai Sudharsan (GT) – 759 runs
 
• Super Striker: Vaibhav Suryavanshi (RR) – 206.6 SR
 
• Most Sixes: Nicholas Pooran (LSG) – 40 sixes
 
• Most Fours: Sai Sudharsan (GT) – 88 fours
 
• Most Dot Balls: Mohammed Siraj (GT) – 151 dot balls
 
• Catch of the Season: Kamindu Mendis (SRH) vs Dewald Brevis
 
• Fairplay Award: Chennai Super Kings
 
• Fantasy King: Sai Sudharsan (GT) – 1495 points
